# Vauta

> Vauta is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) macOS app that captures any call on your Mac, transcribes it on the Mac and writes the minutes: decisions, tasks with owner and date, and open questions. No bot joins the call, nothing is sent to a cloud service, and there is no account. Version 0.9.1, public beta. Runs on Macs with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later; built from source with the Command Line Tools.

Website: https://maquinatech.github.io/Vauta-landing/ (Spanish: https://maquinatech.github.io/Vauta-landing/es/)
Source code: https://github.com/MaquinaTech/Vauta
Author: Nicolás López de Lerma López

## What it does

- Captures both sides of a call: the microphone as "Me" and the call audio as "Others". Works with any call app on the Mac (Zoom, Teams, Meet, FaceTime, Slack, Webex); tested in real calls in Safari so far.
- Transcribes on the Mac, speaker by speaker, and writes minutes. Each decision and task cites the transcript; what it cannot support is marked as unconfirmed.
- Real-time translation: subtitles of what the other participants say, translated into your language.
- Speaker identification: tells voices apart; name a speaker once and the transcript and minutes use that name.
- Notes from your shorthand: type a few words during the call and Vauta writes the full note from what was said, with citations.
- Transcribes every language Apple's speech recognition supports; minutes in the meeting's language or yours.
- Export as Markdown, PDF, JSON, SRT or VTT; import audio or video recordings as meetings.
- Choice of AI model: Apple Intelligence on the Mac, or your own model server at home or at work (LM Studio, Ollama, MLX). Model servers on the internet are refused.

## Connected memory

- Ask: one search over transcripts, minutes, notes and your PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with cited answers.
- Search by meaning in any language with EmbeddingGemma 2 on the Mac (optional, 574 MB, downloaded only when you choose; without it, Ask searches by keywords).
- Links people, projects, clients and topics across meetings, with one list of open tasks and their owners.
- A brief before each meeting: who is coming, what the last meeting with them left open, and related meetings, documents and reminders.
- After a meeting, suggested reminders and calendar events that are added only when you confirm.

## Privacy and security

- Audio is never written to disk; it is transcribed in memory and discarded.
- Transcripts and minutes are stored encrypted (AES-256), with the key in the Keychain; Touch ID to open meetings.
- No account and no telemetry. Transcripts are deleted after 90 days; you choose how long to keep minutes.
- The internet is used only to download a model when you start the download. Vauta never accepts incoming connections, and its Network Activity window lists every connection it makes.

## Compared with other meeting notetakers

ChatGPT, Gemini in Google Meet, Microsoft Teams intelligent recap, Zoom AI, Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai and Granola transcribe in their own cloud and need an account; several need a paid plan for meeting notes. Vauta transcribes on the Mac, needs no account and is free. Vauta runs only on a Mac with Apple silicon, while most of them also run on other platforms. The side-by-side comparison, with sources checked on 27 October 2026, is on the website.
